info.description: Read endpoints of /api/v1 defined in Wave 1 and the access, plan and approval endpoints of Wave 3A. Errors are application/problem+json (RFC 9457) with the ExponetDB error catalog. Observed state carries source and observedAt; a failed live read is an error, never an empty list. Web App sessions send the __Host-exdb_session cookie; mutating requests also need X-CSRF-Token and the exact Origin.
